en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a European spa town square. The scene shows a sloping cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings with shop signs, a decorative fountain or market well in the center, an ornate cast‑iron streetlamp, and to the right a richly carved colonnaded pavilion. Behind it rises a square tower on a hill, with wooded hills forming the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the square. At the bottom margin there is a German caption identifying the location.
